title: Continuidad · noche, caídas y vuelta a casa
description: The joins between blocks (docs/chapter-2.md § Night and the way home, § What changed from the loop design): caught on the Meridiana at night and beaten, the lost screen only offers Despertar, and they wake at eleven the next morning; at the bottom of Emilie's model, Volver a antes del combate leaves El que no converge waiting until Gerard walks off and comes back, and then its fight starts again.

steps.eval: if (!document.querySelector('#battle [data-after="retry"]').hidden || !document.querySelector('#battle [data-after="rewind"]').hidden) throw Error('Beaten on the Meridiana at night: no fighting it again, no stepping back'); if (document.querySelector('#battle [data-after="close"]').textContent !== 'Despertar') throw Error('Despertar')

steps.caption: Caught on the Meridiana at night and beaten: Demasiado fuertes, and only Despertar

steps.eval: if (window.gerard.story.clock.hour !== 11) throw Error('they wake late: ' + window.gerard.story.clock.hour)

steps.caption: The next morning at eleven, in bed: «Las once… Nos han dejado KO en la Meridiana»

steps.eval: if (document.querySelector('#hud[data-battle]') || window.gerard.game.modelo.fighting) throw Error('stepped back: nothing waits on that fight, and it does not start again where they stand')

steps.caption: Volver a antes del combate at the bottom of Emilie's model: still before El que no converge, which waits for Gerard to walk off
Walked off and back: its fight starts again (before, after stepping back nothing ever caught them again, and the model's only way out is through it)
